# Session log record kinds (v0.2.1)

The vocabulary the transcript log accepts, from `harness.sdk.types.RECORD_KINDS`. Every model-visible or user-visible fact is one of these; the log is the source of truth and `derive_messages` is the only producer of a `ModelRequest.messages` list. `Model-visible` marks the kinds `derive_messages` turns into messages — everything else is history the user keeps but the model does not see. Invariants and the upgrade policy are in `docs/architecture/SESSION_LOG.md`.
